extracted.intended_audience: Users of the Magma computer algebra system (mathematicians, researchers, and programmers working with graphs and combinatorial designs)
extracted.subtask_description: Reference documentation for Magma functions and concepts relating to graph theory (distance, connectedness, colourings, automorphism groups, canonical labelling, isomorphism) and incidence structures/designs (constructors, invariants, tests, constructions, and operations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Distance(u, v)
rubrics_metrics.description: Length of a shortest path between u and v, or −1 if they are not connected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returned as an integer; distance matrix is a symmetric p×p integer matrix giving distances between vertices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geodesic(u, v)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sequence of vertices defining a shortest path between u and v, or the empty sequence if they are not connected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for retrieving the actual shortest-path vertex sequence rather than just its length.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ball(u, n)
rubrics_metrics.description: Set of vertices at distance ≤ n from u.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sphere(u, n)
rubrics_metrics.description: Set of vertices at distance n from u.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diameter(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Length of a longest path in G, or −1 if G is not connected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns integer; for disconnected graphs returns −1.

rubrics_metrics.name: DiameterPath(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sequence of vertices defining a longest path in G, or the empty sequence if G is not connected.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsConnected(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if between any pair of vertices of G there is a path.

rubrics_metrics.name: Component(u)
rubrics_metrics.description: Subgraph corresponding to the connected component of the graph containing vertex u.

rubrics_metrics.name: Components(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Connected components of G as a sequence of subsets of vertices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Girth(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Length of a shortest cycle of G.

rubrics_metrics.name: GirthCycle(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sequence of vertices defining a shortest cycle of G.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsEulerian(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if there is a cycle visiting each vertex of G exactly once (i.e., if all vertices have even degree).

rubrics_metrics.name: Independent set (concept)
rubrics_metrics.description: A subset of vertices such that no two of the vertices are adjacent; the subgraph generated by an independent set is empty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as a target for functions that compute independence numbers and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clique (concept)
rubrics_metrics.description: A subset of vertices such that all the vertices are adjacent to one another; the subgraph generated by a clique is complete.

rubrics_metrics.name: CliqueNumber(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the maximum number of elements that a clique of graph G can have.

rubrics_metrics.name: IndependenceNumber(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the maximum number of elements that an independent set of graph G can have.

rubrics_metrics.name: LargestClique(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns an example of a clique attaining the clique number.

rubrics_metrics.name: LargestIndependent(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns an example of an independent set attaining the independence number.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clique(G, n)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a clique of cardinality at least n; returns an empty set if n is larger than the clique number.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independent(G, n)
rubrics_metrics.description: Works similarly to Clique(G,n) but for independent sets: returns an independent set of cardinality at least n or empty set if impossible.

rubrics_metrics.name: ChromaticNumber(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the minimum number of vertex colours required such that no two adjacent vertices have the same colour.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: KCubeGraph(3) has chromatic number 2.

rubrics_metrics.name: ChromaticIndex(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the minimum number of colours required to colour the edges so that no two adjacent edges have the same colour.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: KCubeGraph(3) has chromatic index 3; edge-colouring constrained by maximum degree and parallel classes.

rubrics_metrics.name: AutomorphismGroup(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Constructs the automorphism group A of G (permutations on the vertices resulting in an identical graph).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May return also the canonical graph as second return value when parameter Canonical is true or #G < 500. The resulting group can be used in permutation-group operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: EdgeGroup(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the automorphism group of G in its action on the edges (edge group).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Degree equals number of edges; may be compared with ActionImage of AutomorphismGroup on the G-set of edges.

rubrics_metrics.name: x^a, x^S
rubrics_metrics.description: Image of x under action of automorphism a or subgroup S of A, where x is a vertex, edge, or set/sequence of vertices or edges of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also used to compute action of an automorphism on sets, sequences, graphs, and subgraphs.

rubrics_metrics.name: H^x
rubrics_metrics.description: Image of graph H under action of x, where x is an element or subgroup of A (including A itself).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When applied to subgraphs, computation is done with respect to the main graph; resulting isomorphic graphs are not usually of great interest as they are isomorphic to one another.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsVertexTransitive(G), IsTransitive(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if the automorphism group of G is transitive (vertex-transitive).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsEdgeTransitive(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if the edge group of G is transitive.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsPrimitive(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if automorphism group of G is primitive.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsSymmetric(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if automorphism group of G is symmetric (arc-transitive).

rubrics_metrics.name: OrbitsPartition(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Partition of the vertex-set of G corresponding to orbits of automorphism group A of G.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stabilizer(S, x)
rubrics_metrics.description: Stabilizer of x in the subgroup S of A, where x is a vertex, edge, or set/sequence of vertices or edges.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsDistanceTransitive(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if for all vertices u, v, w, t in connected graph G such that d(u, v) = d(w, t), there exists a ∈ A such that ua = w and va = t.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsDistanceRegular(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if G is distance regular.

rubrics_metrics.name: IntersectionArray(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Intersection array of a distance regular graph G.

rubrics_metrics.name: CanonicalGraph(G)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the canonical labelling of G (canonical graph) which is isomorphic to G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Canonical graph may also be returned by AutomorphismGroup(G) when Canonical is true or #G < 500; used to test isomorphism by equality of canonical graphs.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsIsomorphic(G, H)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tests whether two graphs G and H are isomorphic; returns true/false and, if true, also returns the isomorphism mapping from vertices of G to vertices of H.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One-step function; examples show returns mapping object.

rubrics_metrics.name: IncidenceStructure / NearLinearSpace / LinearSpace / Design constructors
rubrics_metrics.description: Constructors for incidence structures: IncidenceStructure< point-set | block-set >, NearLinearSpace< ... >, LinearSpace< ... >, Design< t, point-set | block-set >.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Constructors return the incidence structure and the point-set and block-set. For non-Inc categories, blocks/lines must satisfy additional restrictions which Magma checks by default (can be disabled via Check := false).

rubrics_metrics.name: Incidence structure: simple / uniform / t-balanced (definitions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Simple: no repeated blocks. Uniform with blocksize k: each block contains exactly k points. t-balanced: every t-subset of the point set is contained in exactly λ blocks for some λ ≥ 1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A t-(v,k,λ) design is simple, uniform, and t-balanced with at least one block; Steiner design has λ = 1; symmetric design has b = v and t ≥ 2.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ways to specify points (constructors)
rubrics_metrics.description: Points may be given as an indexed set P of cardinality v, or as the integer v (point-set taken as {@1,..,v@}).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ways to specify blocks (constructors)
rubrics_metrics.description: Blocks may be given as a v×b 0/1 matrix (incidence matrix), as a set of codeword supports from a linear code of length v, or as a comma-separated list (each item a subset of P, a block of existing structure, or sequence/indexed set of these).

rubrics_metrics.name: Behavior when constructors' checks are expensive (Check parameter)
rubrics_metrics.description: Constructors NearLinearSpace, LinearSpace, and Design accept parameter Check (default true); set Check := false to skip verifying category conditions (user takes responsibility).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: constructing large design with Check := false is dramatically faster than with checking enabled.

rubrics_metrics.name: IncidenceMatrix(I)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the incidence matrix of incidence structure I.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsSimple(I)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if incidence structure I has no repeated blocks.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsUniform(I)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if I has at least one block and the blocksize k is constant; if true, also returns k.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsTrivial(I)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if design D is trivial.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsSelfDual(I)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if I is isomorphic to its dual.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsBalanced(I, t)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if incidence structure I is balanced with respect to t; if true, also returns λ. Parameter Al specifies algorithm (default "NoOrbits" brute-force, alternative "Orbits" uses automorphism orbits).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choosing algorithm affects performance; example timings illustrate differences.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsResolvable(I)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if there exists a resolution of I (a partition of the blocks of D into parallel classes); if true, also returns a resolution.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsNearLinearSpace(I)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if I is a near-linear space.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsLinearSpace(I)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if I is a linear space.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsDesign(I, t)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if I is a t-design; if true, also returns λ. Parameter Al specifies algorithm.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsPointRegular(L)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if (near-)linear space L is point regular; if true, also returns the point regularity.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsLineRegular(L)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if (near-)linear space L is line regular; if true, also returns the line regularity.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsComplete(D)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if design D is complete.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsSymmetric(D)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if design D satisfies t ≥ 2 and v = b (symmetric).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsSteiner(D, t)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if design D is a Steiner t-design (i.e., λ = 1).

rubrics_metrics.name: PointSet(I), BlockSet(I)
rubrics_metrics.description: Return the special categories IncPtSet and IncBlkSet representing the point-set P and block-set B of incidence structure I (parents for points and blocks respectively).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are not true Magma sets but special parents for points/blocks; use Points(I) and Blocks(I) to get indexed sets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Points(I), Blocks(I)
rubrics_metrics.description: Return the points and blocks of I explicitly as indexed sets (reflecting ordering of points and blocks).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be careful not to confuse these with PointSet(I)/BlockSet(I).

rubrics_metrics.name: Support(I) and Support(b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Support(I) returns the indexed set of points in the original universe used to create I; Support(b) returns the underlying points in block b in the original universe.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful when the point-set is not {@1..v@}.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rep / Random (points and blocks)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rep(P), Random(P), Rep(B), Random(B), Rep(b), Random(b) return representative or random elements of point-sets, block-sets, and individual blocks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Point(I, i), Block(I, i), P!x
rubrics_metrics.description: Point(I,i) returns ith point of incidence structure I with point-set P; Block(I,i) returns ith block; P!x gives point corresponding to element x of the indexed set used to create I.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Remember the distinction between labeling and ordering of points when original universe differs from {@1..v@}.

rubrics_metrics.name: PointDegrees(I), BlockDegrees(I), BlockSizes(I)
rubrics_metrics.description: PointDegrees(I) returns sequence whose ith term is the number of blocks containing P.i; BlockDegrees/BlockSizes return sequence of number of points in each block.

rubrics_metrics.name: Covalence(I, S)
rubrics_metrics.description: Given subset S of point-set of I, return number of blocks of I containing S.

rubrics_metrics.name: Set(b), Support(b) (block operations)
rubrics_metrics.description: Set(b) gives set of points in block b as a true enumerated set; Support(b) returns set of underlying points in block b in original universe.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Set(b) when a true SetEnum is required (e.g., for set-operators).

rubrics_metrics.name: p in b, p notin b; S subset b, S notsubset b
rubrics_metrics.description: Boolean tests for membership of point p in block b and subset tests for S relative to block b.

rubrics_metrics.name: PointDegree(I, p); BlockDegree(I, b); BlockSize(I, b), #b
rubrics_metrics.description: Return number of blocks containing point p (PointDegree) and number of points in block b (BlockDegree/BlockSize/#b).

rubrics_metrics.name: ConnectionNumber(I, p, b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of blocks joining point p to block b in I.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsBlock(I, S)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if set or block S represents a block of I; if true, also returns one such block.

rubrics_metrics.name: Block(I, p, q), Line(I, p, q)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns a block (line) of I containing points p and q if it exists (in a linear space the line exists uniquely unless p = q).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsParallelClass(I, b, c)
rubrics_metrics.description: true if there is a parallel class of I containing blocks b and c; if true, also returns one such class.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parameters(D); ReplicationNumber(D); PascalTriangle(D); IntersectionNumber(D, i, j); Order(D)
rubrics_metrics.description: Functions returning elementary invariants of a design: Parameters(D) returns record with fields t,v,b,r,k,lambda; ReplicationNumber(D) returns r; IntersectionNumber(D,i,j) returns block intersection numbers λ_i^j; PascalTriangle(D) returns 'Pascal triangle' of λ-values; Order(D) returns order λ1 of D (t ≥ 2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PascalTriangle(D) printed in formatted style; triangle size depends on whether D is Steiner.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operations producing new incidence structures (Complement, Dual, Contraction, Residual, Simplify, Sum, Union, Restriction)
rubrics_metrics.description: Complement(I), Dual(I), Contraction(I,p), Contraction(I,b), Residual(I,p), Residual(I,b), Simplify(I) (remove repeated blocks), Sum(Q) (union of block-sets over same point-set), Union(I1,I2) (disjoint union of point-sets and union of block-sets), Restriction(L,S) (restrict near-/linear space to S).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each operation's resulting (π, β) point-set and block-set semantics are provided; Dual may not return optimal t automatically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Changing categories (NearLinearSpace(I), IncidenceStructure(I), LinearSpace(I), Design(I,t))
rubrics_metrics.description: Conversion functions to change the category of an incidence structure to IncNsp, Inc, IncLsp, or Dsgn respectively when the structure satisfies the relevant properties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Converting allows application of category-specific operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: WittDesign(n)
rubrics_metrics.description: WittDesign(12) returns the 5-(12,6,1) Witt design; WittDesign(24) returns the 5-(24,8,1) Witt design.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Famous constructions provided as built-ins.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsHadamard(M); IsHadamardEquivalent(H, J)
rubrics_metrics.description: IsHadamard(M) tests whether matrix M is a Hadamard matrix; IsHadamardEquivalent(H,J) tests equivalence of Hadamard matrices H and J.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used in construction of Hadamard designs.

rubrics_metrics.name: HadamardRowDesign(H, i); HadamardColumnDesign(H, i)
rubrics_metrics.description: Construct Hadamard 3-design corresponding to row i (or column i) of Hadamard matrix H (n×n with n ≥ 4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: constructing 3-(8,4,1) design from 8×8 Hadamard matrix.

rubrics_metrics.name: DifferenceSet(p, t); SingerDifferenceSet(n, q); IsDifferenceSet(B)
rubrics_metrics.description: DifferenceSet(p,t) constructs a difference set of a specified type t for prime p (Marshall Hall types). SingerDifferenceSet constructs Singer difference sets. IsDifferenceSet(B) tests whether B is a difference set over ZZ/mZZ or an iterable finite group and, if true, returns λ.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Difference sets may have additive form in residue class rings; types impose conditions on p.

rubrics_metrics.name: Development(B); Development(T)
rubrics_metrics.description: Development(B) given a difference set B (relative to group A) returns symmetric design with point set A and blocks obtained by translating B by each element of A. Development(T) for a difference family T returns incidence structure whose ith block is union of family translated by ith element of A.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to generate designs from (families of) difference sets.
